ModMetaData.name: RimCBM
ModMetaData.author: CH4AcKO3
ModMetaData.description: Alpha implant framework for RimWorld 1.6, inspired by Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. Plan body grids, shared W/Wd power, surgery, abilities, maintenance and fuel/charging logistics. Includes prototype modules, a health-panel extension and native context controls. Requires Harmony. Supports English and 简体中文. Content progression and balance are in development; CE and third-party integrations are not certified.
